motivatingPathology: Table edits track at cell level: a steady cell beside a cell carrying an insertion marker with author and timestamp in its cell properties. Cell insertions record structural table edits that run-level markup cannot express, and the marker lives in tcPr rather than in a run. The engine must carry the cell marker with its metadata plus both cell paragraphs through the round trip without promoting the marker into text or dropping it from the properties.
knownLimitations: One inserted cell exercises the shape; deleted and merged cell markers are not covered. Cell markers combined with merges in the same cell are absent. Row-level insert and delete markers are out of scope. Accept and reject semantics for cell edits are not asserted.
scopeExclusions: This fixture does not exercise run insertions, deletions, move ranges, or multiscript runs; those live in sibling fixtures. Table structure itself is covered by the table fixtures, not here. Rendered table-edit indicators are never compared; only markup preservation and schema validity are.
ecma376Difficulty: Cell revision markers live inside cell properties in schema order, with author, date, and id attributes that must survive exactly. A writer that re-serializes cell properties from a model lacking revision state drops the marker while keeping the cell, silently accepting the edit. The marker must keep its position and attributes or the tracked edit disappears.
licenseProvenance: Hand-built for this corpus from the ECMA-376 transitional schema; no third-party source material; fixture bytes under the repository license.

disposition.reason: Cell-level insertion markers are Word-legal and safe, so the engine preserves them: the table node checksum is identical after the round trip and the package validates clean.
